column2: (2)  The  issue  of  securities  of  the  Government  shall  be
made through the Central Bank, which shall act as agent of
the Government, and for the account of the Government:
Provided,  however,  that  the  Central  Bank  shall  not
subscribe to any issue of such securities or agree to purchase
the unsubscribed portion of any such issue.
